title: ArtifactManifestEntry
description:
One heavy artifact declared by a submission.

An author may omit `sha256` and `size_bytes`; the client computes both from the local file before any registration call, so a request sent to the server carries both and the server refuses an entry missing either.

content_type.description: Optional MIME type for the stored object.

relative_path.description: Validated path below the registered card's artifact prefix.

sha256.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 digest of the artifact bytes; computed by the client when authored without one.

size_bytes.description: Artifact size in bytes; computed by the client when authored without one.
